_comment: City definition. Districts map to providers via 'source'; the collector's measured numbers decide how built each one is. Edit this, or have a model generate it. Reload to apply.

_schema.projects[].name: shown in the legend
_schema.projects[].source: provider id from usage.json: hermes | openrouter | zai | opencode | gemini. Omit for a district the AI adds itself.
_schema.projects[].kind: provider | project | idea. Free text for humans; the renderer ignores it.
_schema.projects[].evidence: WHY this district exists — a real thing it maps to. Required on any district the AI adds. No evidence, no district.
_schema.projects[].reference: { metric, full } - the scale at which this district is fully built. Used only when the provider reports no limit of its own.
_schema.projects[].tokenShare: 0..1 FALLBACK, used only when the provider returns no data. A placeholder, not a measurement.
_schema.projects[].origin: { x, z } centre of the district on the island
_schema.projects[].tier: 0 = ground (default). 1+ raises the district onto a deck that many levels up, with support columns and a rim, so the city grows UP as well as out. Set it only when a district has earned it.
_schema.projects[].style: one of: civic | laboratory | residential | archive | industrial

projects.name: Plugin Foundry
projects.evidence: Published Omarchy shell plugins — repo a77lic7ion/omarchy-plugin-updates
